recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Future changes to biologicallyderivedproduct-processing or biologicallyderivedproduct-manipulation should be handled through the FHIR Extension Pack workflow rather than by reintroducing extension source files into core.

initial_application: The base BiologicallyDerivedProduct processing/manipulation elements were removed during the R5 BiologicallyDerivedProduct replacement work, and the FHIR-33067 branch then added/fixed biologicallyderivedproduct-processing and biologicallyderivedproduct-manipulation extension definitions before PR #1771 was merged. The Jira comment links the PR-branch merge 6aac063, while the substantive commits include ae34831c, 7d6d526f, ff52553b, and a2ea3f25.
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct remains active in source/fhir.ini. Core later removed R5 extension definitions from the FHIR checkout in dd468d4f as part of moving extensions out of core source. The current FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains both replacement StructureDefinitions with BiologicallyDerivedProduct context. Later FHIR-extensions issues FHIR-53206 and FHIR-53259 concern external maintenance of the manipulation extension and do not require a core edit for this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current core resource already omits the two base attributes and the replacement extensions exist in the external Extension Pack source.
